articles.title: Oscar Bobo: Final Debarment Order

FDA bases this order on a finding that Mr. Bobo engaged in a pattern of importing or offering for import misbranded drugs (i.e., in an amount, frequency, or dosage that is inconsistent with his personal or household use) that are not designated in an authorized electronic data interchange system as products regulated by FDA. Mr. Bobo was given notice of the proposed debarment and was given an opportunity to request a hearing to show why he should not be debarred. As of March 25, 2026 (30 days after receipt of the notice), Mr. Bobo had not responded. Mr. Bobo's failure to respond and request a hearing constitutes a waiver of his right to a hearing concerning this matter.
